TRAINING REIMBURSEMENT AGREEMENT

This Training Reimbursement Agreement is entered into as of August 3, 2026 between Pacific Crest Dental Group, Inc. ("Employer") and Morgan Avery ("Employee").

1. Training Program. Employer will enroll Employee in its dental assistant training program.

2. Obligation. Employee owes Employer the value of the training program, as Employer determines it, together with a replacement hire fee, and the whole sum is due on Employee's last day.

3. At-Will Employment. Employee's employment remains at will.

4. Governing Law. This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of California.
